latestVersion.changelog:
flightAI 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides AI-powered domestic flight search, fare inquiry, booking, rescheduling, and refund functionality via command-line scripts.
- Requires user authentication via phone verification before any operations.
- Supports end-to-end flight service scenarios: search, fare details, seat rules, booking, order details, cancelation, rescheduling, and refund (including related fee calculations).
- Ensures user privacy: clearly communicates PII handling and requires explicit user consent.
- Step-by-step, context-aware parameter handling for smooth user experience.
- Includes complete usage instructions and example workflows.
